candidates.title: DUAL-BLADE: Dual-Path NVMe-Direct KV-Cache Offloading for Edge LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Direct SSD/NVMe KV offload design dynamically selects page-cache versus filesystem-bypassing NVMe-direct paths; reports up to 33.1% prefill and 57.8% decode latency reduction.

candidates.title: Foundry: Template-Based CUDA Graph Context Materialization for Fast LLM Serving Cold Start
candidates.reason: GPU-runtime serving work persists CUDA graph topology/context offline and materializes it online; up to 99% cold-start reduction, including Qwen3-235B-A22B from 10 minutes to 3.9 seconds.

candidates.title: PersistentKV: Page-Aware Decode Scheduling for Long-Context LLM Serving on Commodity GPUs
candidates.reason: Adaptive native-paged decode scheduling on commodity GPU chooses among FlashInfer, sequence splitting and workqueue execution based on active batch/context shape; useful runtime scheduling lineage.
